Hanifi Rohingya Keyboard

Native Windows Keyboard & Predictive IME

Type in the box or click the keys. Use Shift for tone marks and punctuation. Text flows right to left.

V = vowel A · Shift+H/T/A = tone signs · Shift+` = gemination · Shift+Space = Sakin. Ctrl, Alt, and Command shortcuts remain available.

Download native Windows keyboard

This page is an offline practice editor. Extract the Windows ZIP and run Install.cmd to type in Windows applications. Switch keyboards with Win+Space. Select “Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya” in your document and enable right-to-left paragraph direction.
